findings.title: Plugin request log line no longer includes traceID
findings.body: The old logRequest explicitly appended a "traceID" field from the context (via tracing.TraceIDFromContext) to the "Plugin Request Completed" log line. That block was removed. The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware (contextual_logger_middleware.go, instrumentContext) only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname, and does not add traceID. Unless the infra logger's FromContext happens to add trace IDs (nothing in this diff shows that), completed-request logs lose their trace correlation, a regression for anyone correlating plugin egress logs with traces.

findings.title: Logger middleware now depends on ContextualLoggerMiddleware being earlier in the chain
findings.body: LoggerMiddleware no longer adds pluginId, endpoint, dsName, dsUID or uname itself. It relies entirely on m.logger.FromContext(ctx) picking up attributes injected by ContextualLoggerMiddleware. That ordering is only enforced by the comment-free slice in pluginsintegration.go CreateMiddlewares. Any future reordering, or any caller composing LoggerMiddleware without the contextual middleware (or with metrics removed), silently drops all plugin/datasource identifiers from the egress log, and nothing fails at compile time or in tests.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no tests
findings.body: The middleware and the moved instrumentContext logic are new in this file, and the logging contract (which attributes are attached to the context, and that LoggerMiddleware picks them up) has no unit test. metrics_middleware_test.go was only renamed, and its test still covers only metrics. Since the change moves log-enrichment responsibility across middlewares, a test asserting the contextual attributes reach the logger would catch the ordering and traceID regressions above.

findings.title: Test still named for the old InstrumentationMiddleware
findings.body: The test function is still TestInstrumentationMiddleware even though the file and type were renamed to MetricsMiddleware. This leaves the naming inconsistent with the stated goal of the PR.

findings.title: Logger still registered under the old 'instrumentation' name
findings.body: The LoggerMiddleware is still constructed with log.New("plugin.instrumentation"), which keeps the old naming this PR is meant to clean up. Log consumers filtering on the logger name will see the stale name.
